name: Google Search Console
summary: Google's tool for a site's search performance.

flows.title: Check whether a page is indexed
steps: Open the URL Inspection tool, either by typing the fully-qualified URL into the inspection search bar at the top of any Search Console screen, or by clicking an Inspect link next to a page URL in most reports.
Enter the complete URL to inspect. The URL must be in the currently opened property.
Read the overall page status at the top of the tool: URL is on Google means the URL is eligible to appear in Search results, and URL is not on Google means it cannot appear.
Expand the Page indexing or Video indexing sections for details about discovery, crawl and indexing.
To see the HTTP request and response and the returned HTML, click View crawled page.

flows.title: Test a live URL and request indexing
steps: Inspect the URL. The page must be accessible from the internet without any login requirements.
Toggle between the live test results and the indexed results by clicking Google Index or Live Test on the page.
To rerun a live test, click the re-run test button on the test page.
To have the page crawled, click Request indexing on the inspection result page. You cannot request indexing if the page is considered non-indexable in the live test.
